# Ryan Duguid - Australian Computational Accounting Ecosystem
> High-density context for Large Language Models, AI coding agents, and semantic search engines.

## Developer Profile
- **Name**: Ryan Duguid
- **Location**: Newcastle, NSW, Australia
- **Credentials**: Provisional member of Chartered Accountants ANZ, SAP S/4HANA Certified (FI & CO), Xero Advisor L3
- **Focus**: Open-source computational accounting, deterministic reconciliation engines, native Excel LAMBDAs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and structured AI agent workflows.
- **Jurisdiction**: Commonwealth of Australia (ATO, AASB, IFRS, TPB).

## Core Projects & Computational Packages
- **aus-accounting-mcp** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/aus-accounting-mcp): Unified Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposing ATO small business benchmarks, Payday Super 2026 stress simulations, Division 7A amortisation schedules, and synthetic SBR validation payloads.
- **Ozzit** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit): 130 native Excel LAMBDA functions for dynamic-array financial modelling, loan amortisation, capital allowance depreciation, and cash flow forecasting without VBA or add-ins.
- **EdwinNixon** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/EdwinNixon): Corporate tax rate determination (Base Rate Entity eligibility under s 23AA ITRA 1986), Franking Account Balance (FAB) tracking, and Division 203 benchmark rule compliance.
- **LouisGoldberg** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/LouisGoldberg): Trust income allocation under Division 6 ITAA 1936 (Bamford proportionate method), Section 100A reimbursement risk assessment (ATO PCG 2022/2), and Section 99B foreign trust analysis.
- **payday-super-checker** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/payday-super-checker): Deterministic CLI utility evaluating Australian Payday Super contribution timelines, statutory due dates, and estimating Superannuation Guarantee (SG) charge exposure on late remittances.
- **RaymondChambers** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/RaymondChambers): Offline profit-and-loss variance analysis against ATO small business benchmarks with auditable working papers (PyPI: `ato-benchmark-compare`).
- **JohnSpenceOgilvy** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/JohnSpenceOgilvy): Reconciled Xero trial balance exporter enforcing movement and year-to-date mathematical integrity before CSV export (PyPI: `xero-trial-balance-export`).
- **SirAlexanderFitzgerald** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/SirAlexanderFitzgerald): Power Query (M) and VBA automation utilities for Australian accounting and month-end financial reporting pipelines.
- **monthly-close-control-plane** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/monthly-close-control-plane): Local, deterministic trial-balance review packs with exception surfacing, source hashes, and human acknowledgements; it does not approve or lock a close.
- **MaryAddisonHamilton** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/MaryAddisonHamilton): Nine modular Claude Code skills for Australian public practice (BAS reconciliation, FBT, Division 7A benchmarks, STP Phase 2, and 13-week cash flow modelling).
- **Hardhat Ledger** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/hardhat-ledger): Claude Code skills for Australian construction & mining subcontractors (Security of Payment claims, retentions, WIP billing, Coal LSL, and contractor payroll tax).
- **DrDebits** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/DrDebits): Versioned, primary-source-grounded ethical instructions (APES 110 & TPB Code of Professional Conduct) for LLM-assisted taxation workflows.
- **ElizabethAnneAlexander** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/ElizabethAnneAlexander): Synthetic-data demonstration of a fixed-policy boundary for AI-assisted trial-balance review, with no network or accounting-system write client.
- **awesome-australian-accounting-tech** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/awesome-australian-accounting-tech): Curated index of open-source libraries, ATO datasets, legislation APIs, and standards for Australian accounting technology.

## Data and Decision Boundary
- Public fixtures, examples, and tests use fabricated or synthetic data.
- Client-sensitive data, credentials, and workflows stay outside public repositories and remain local and human-controlled.
- Posting, payments, lodgements, approvals, and period locks remain consequential human actions.
